name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_InitFromParams

evidence: Only caller is the named Party_InitMemberRoster; the old vtable-0x764F58 anchor is not visible in the readable body and nothing else points at an overlay class.

name: Menu_FindFreeSlotRecord
summary: Scans the five 0x40-byte menu slot records for one whose id triple is still 0xFF/0xFF/0xFFFF and returns its index (0 when all are used).
evidence: The five-slot id test at +0x4C/+0x4D/+0x4E is visible and matches the confident Menu_AssignActorToFreeSlot layout; caller Battle_UiFlow_NotifyMenuUpdate runs it while rebuilding the menu.

name: maybe_Battle_SelectCommandTarget
signature: void maybe_Battle_SelectCommandTarget(void *action, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)

evidence: No callers; the only surviving statement is the mis-marked std_ConstructArray call.

name: maybe_Ui_InitFourTripleByteSlots

name: Menu_FindActorSlot

name: maybe_Ui_Widget_SetVisibleFlag

name: maybe_Ui_BattleCmd_ConstructCommands

summary: Stores the id twice plus -1 at self+0/+4/+8 and constructs two 0x20-byte records in the global buffer 0x007EF0F4 with a zeroing constructor.

name: maybe_Queue_SubmitEntry
summary: Appends a buffer entry to the owner's submission chain, publishes it with a memory barrier, pushes to the OS queue or ring buffer and returns the next sequence number.

name: Snd_SetChannelDescriptor

summary: Copies mask-selected descriptor fields (bit0/bit1/bit2) into one 0x34-byte channel record of the +0x10A4 table and marks the channel dirty.

name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelPan

name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_Ctor
summary: One-shot constructor of a 0x37C-byte layout block: lazily allocates and zeroes the block, installs g_uiLayoutBlockVtable, sets 0xFF/0 defaults and constructs eight sub-records at +0x2C.

name: Field_CreateStateObject
summary: In-place initialiser of the field state object: installs g_fieldStateObjectVtable, clears the state bytes and zero-fills a 0x12-byte counter block whose first byte is set to 1.

name: Field_ItemInfoWindow_Ctor
summary: Constructs the field's item-info window object: installs g_uiItemInfoWindowObjectVtable, embeds a composite window at +4 and clears the colour/fade fields at +0x114..+0x140.

name: DataManager_ResolveTwoIds
signature: void DataManager_ResolveTwoIds(void *ctx, u32 id1, u32 id2)
summary: Resolves two ids through the data manager into ctx+4 and ctx+8 (the data-manager lazy construction inlined here is the compiler's local-static guard).
evidence: Nine callers from unrelated subsystems (hitbox loaders, NPC actions, UI constructors) all use it as the shared two-id lookup helper; both stores go through func_002D71AC on g_dataManager.

name: maybe_Ui_Object_SetOwner
summary: Stores a new scale/owner value and notifies the child object through vtable+8, then clears its active flag through vtable+0xC(0).
evidence: The argument arrives in in_s0 (VFP argument trap per FACTS) and two callers are garbage symbols (tEb, LFb).

name: maybe_Field_Action_EndCut
summary: Clears the field object's action state on (work+8)->+0x48 and hides the model attach slots when the owner byte +0x23C is set; mirror of the Start variant.

name: maybe_Field_Action_EndDig

name: Ui_ItemScreen_CloseList
summary: Closes the item-screen list: resets the shop/list helpers, reads the selected member id from the cursor at +0x1E7C, ends the text scroll with it, and installs the handler pair from g_uiItemScreenSelectCallbacks.
evidence: It installs g_uiItemScreenSelectCallbacks and uses Ui_ListCursor_GetSelectedMemberId/Ui_TextScroll_End, which pins the item-screen family.

name: Ui_ShopWindowState_HandleEvent
summary: One step of the shop-window state machine: forwards the current input event x/y/z to the cursor widget at screen+0x184 via vtable+0x3C and, on event bit 0x102, dispatches to the confirm/step helpers and swaps in the next handler pair from g_uiShopWindowStateCallbacks.
evidence: All handler pairs come from the confident g_uiShopWindowStateCallbacks and the dispatch callees are the shop item-list confirm/set-state functions, so the state belongs to the shop window.

name: maybe_Gfx_Effect2D_CreateStartSlotVariant
summary: Builds a parameter block, fills a small string via func_0011142C and allocates a handle of type 0xB3 through Mem_AllocHandle, storing it at arg1+4.
evidence: No callers; the Effect2D attribution comes only from neighbourhood and the property getter in the block, so it stays unproven.
